title: 2-node cc2538dk TSCH with LPM enabled — RCOSC clock-downshift regression

test.description: Two cc2538 nodes over TSCH with LPM enabled (node 1 = RPL root + TSCH coordinator, node 2 = leaf). Unlike the shipped test-tsch-cc2538dk.json — whose firmware never lowers the oscillator, so it is insensitive to the clock bug — this firmware actually enters PM1/2, which exercises the CLOCK_CTRL.OSC switch path. On unfixed main the firmware's oscillator-switch poll never terminates (the node wedges) and, once that is unblocked, the RCOSC downshift runs the leaf's TSCH slot code at half speed, producing a !dl-miss storm that desyncs it; either way the leaf never becomes reachable. With the cc2538_sys_ctrl clock fix the leaf joins the DAG and resolves the root. Pass criterion: the leaf prints '[LEAF] reachable' (~33 s simulated).
